solution.p: f_x(P) is zero because f does not change as we move left-to-right.
f_y(P) is negative because f decreases as we move up.
f_{xx}(P) is zero because f_x does not change as we move left-to-right.
f_{yy}(P) is positive because f_y increases as we move up.
f_{xy}(P) is zero because f_{y} does not change as we go left-to-right.
f_x(P) is negative because f decreases as we move left-to-right.
f_y(P) is zero because f does not change as we move up or down.
f_{xx}(P) is positive because f_x increases as we move left-to-right.
f_{yy}(P) is zero because f_y does not change as we move up or down.
f_{xy}(P) is zero because f_{x} does not change as we go up.
